combat.modifiedpvp.combo.variety: Mix your attacks to finish the combo
combat.modifiedpvp.combo.sword_special: Next charged hit is a critical
combat.modifiedpvp.combo.axe_special: Next heavy: extra damage or a guard break
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.root.des: Unlock a special move for each weapon.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.sword.de: Kill 50 mobs with a sword. A 5-hit combo mixing swings and thrusts makes the next charged hit a critical. Damage interrupts it. 60 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.dual.des: Kill 50 mobs while dual wielding swords. A 7-hit combo that alternates hands grants a short attack-speed flurry. Missing the offhand exposes you. 120 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.axe.desc: Land 20 heavy attacks. A 3-hit combo empowers the next heavy with extra damage or a guard break. No full stun in PvP. 50 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.bow.desc: Hit 10 different mobs with a bow. A 7-hit combo grants 3 precision shots with instant draw. Damage interrupts it. 30 second cooldown.
Pull a drowned with a trident. A 5-pull combo briefly exposes the last target. 60 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.shield.d: Block 30 hits with a shield. A 3-block combo makes the next block shove the attacker. Damage that gets through interrupts it. 45 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.mace.des: Land 10 chain throws. A 3-hit combo, from a smash or the chain, makes the next hit pull targets in and inflict Slowness II for 4 seconds. You take no damage between those hits. 70 second cooldown.
advancements.modifiedpvp.combat.spear.de: Land 10 perfect Counter Strikes against hostile mobs. Build Pressure until Broken Defense, then choose Total Reaction (Z) or Circular Collapse (jab). Counter Strike and Pressure work before the unlock.
